basic_info.description: Move in ready single family home with a leased solar power system in a desirable Excelsior neighborhood.  Gourmet eat-in kitchen with stone countertops, stainless steel appliances, tile flooring, and access to the covered patio and the considerable rear yard. Large living room for entertaining. Two generous bedrooms with hardwood floors, double panel windows, and large closets. Expansion potential with two spacious high ceiling bonus rooms down on a big lot.  Great Excelsior location near McLaren Park and quick access to 101 and 280 Freeways, walking distance to grocery stores, restaurants, public transportation along the vibrant Mission Street.
